title: Fishing in Kenya
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts: Lake Victoria is the main inland fishing ground; Nile perch and tilapia; nets with small holes catch young fish.

skills.key_step: The child names and locates Kenya's main inland fishing grounds and tells inland from the sea.

floor.prerequisite: Knows lakes and rivers give fish.
floor.question: Name one thing people get from a lake.

representations: a map of Kenya with lakes and dams
steps: Ask: is it inland or the sea?
Ask: does it have fish to catch?
Name it as a fishing ground.
contexts: Lake Victoria fishing boats at Dunga
fish farming in a pond in Kakamega

board.do: Draw Kenya with three lakes and the coast.
Point at the biggest lake in the west.
board.say: What is this main fishing ground?

board.do: Write inland beside the lakes and sea beside the coast.

misconceptions.ask: Which of these is an inland fishing ground?
misconceptions.repair: Inland means within the country, away from the sea. Sort water bodies on a described map.

misconceptions.ask: Which lake is a main fishing ground?
misconceptions.repair: Ask whether fish can live in water full of soda.
Link the lake to the dry north and Lodwar town. Lake Victoria is western.

listen_for: No, fish only come from lakes
misconceptions.ask: Can fish be farmed in Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Show a photo of a fish pond in a farmer's shamba.

checks.question: What is Kenya's main inland fishing ground?
Is the Indian Ocean an inland fishing ground?

skills.key_step: The child says how fishing helps Kenya (food, jobs, money at home and abroad) and how to keep fish for the future.

floor.question: Name one inland fishing ground.
floor.answer: any lake such as Lake Victoria

representations: a chain: fisher, trader, processor, buyer
steps: Say how to keep fish for later.
contexts: fish traders at a beach market
a fish processing plant in Kisumu

board.do: Draw a fish with four arrows out.
Wait for fisher, trader, buyer, Kenya.
Write a gain on each arrow.

listen_for: It only feeds the fishing family
misconceptions.ask: How does fishing help the country as well as the family?
misconceptions.repair: Follow one fish from the boat to the market, the factory and the plate.

misconceptions.ask: Why should fishers not catch young fish?
misconceptions.repair: Compare catching all the chickens with keeping some to lay eggs.

misconceptions.ask: Is Nile perch from Lake Victoria sold abroad?
misconceptions.repair: Trace the route of Nile perch fillets from Kisumu to the airport.

listen_for: It is not; it catches more fish
misconceptions.ask: Why is a net with very small holes bad for fishing?
misconceptions.repair: Pour beans and rice through two sieves: the fine one keeps even the smallest.

checks.question: Give two ways fishing helps Kenya.
checks.answer: any two of: food, jobs, income, money from exports

checks.question: Why should fishers not catch young fish?
checks.answer: So fish can grow and breed for the future
